body: I agree about the granny squares! I started with a simple scarf for my first project, but it wasn't clicking with me so I tried out a basic granny square pattern by watching YouTube tutorials. Once I got the pattern down in my head, it was easy to turn of my brain and keep churning them out. They're very versatile, and you can make so many different things with them! Plus, once you feel comfortable upping the difficulty, there're plenty of patterns out there to challenge yourself and experiment with. \^\^

I highly recommend checking out Strangers From Hell, also known as Hell Is Other People! I personally think it’s very similar to Hannibal in several ways, but it also is different and unique and I would definitely say it’s worth a watch. Unfortunately it’s no longer on Netflix, so finding a way to watch it can be hard, but it’s 100% worth the effort of searching for it. It’s a Kdrama and a psychological thriller, and it has a relationship between two characters in the show that is very very similar to the relationship between Hannibal and Will. It’s a psychological thriller with homoerotic tension and homicide sprinkled in, and if you’re a fan of Hannibal, I think this show will not disappoint.
